title: 壩基排水廊道
summary: 本課以壩基排水廊道為入口，深入排水廊道的揚壓控制、量測分區與性能退化。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
summaryEn: Using Dam-foundation drainage galleries as its entry point, this course examines gallery uplift control, monitoring zones and performance degradation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米壩長底寬40 m，水頭在x=0、10、40 m為40、10、5 m，分段線性積分水頭面積475 m²，揚力9.81×475=4659.75 kN/m。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 排水導度敏感度固定上游水頭50 m、出口10 m與入流導度0.002 m²/s，只將排出導度由0.008降為0.004 m²/s。節點穩態水頭H=(CinHu+CoutHd)/(Cin+Cout)由18升至23.333 m；排水導度減半並不令水頭翻倍。這是線性集總網路兩個穩態的比較，沒有描述堵塞後升壓的時間過程或三維裂隙分布。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume base width 40 m and heads 40, 10 and 5 m at x=0, 10 and 40 m. Piecewise-linear head area 475 m² gives uplift 4659.75 kN/m. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and inflow conductance 0.002 m²/s fixed, reducing only outflow conductance from 0.008 to 0.004 m²/s. Steady node head H=(CinHu+CoutHd)/(Cin+Cout) rises from 18 to 23.333 m; halving drainage conductance does not double head. The linear lumped network compares two steady states, excluding transient pressurization and three-dimensional fractures.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水力阻力與廊道水頭」與「揚壓分布與合力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic resistance and gallery head" and "Uplift distribution and resultant": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance and gallery head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水力阻力與廊道水頭」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水不是把壩基孔壓直接設為零，而是建立通向較低水頭邊界的有限導水路徑。岩體入流與排水出口共同決定節點水頭，出口淹沒會抬高整個系統的基準。 假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。 若只看排出流量，出口淹沒與排水阻塞可能產生相似結果，但內部壓力未必相同。非線性裂隙、暫態儲水和旁通通道會使單節點模型不足以定位異常。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水力阻力與廊道水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drainage does not simply set foundation pressure to zero. It provides finite conductance toward a lower-head boundary, while rock inflow and outlet conditions jointly establish the internal node head and submerged outlets raise that reference. Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network. Outlet submergence and obstruction can produce similar flow changes with different internal pressures. Nonlinear fractures, transient storage and bypass paths can make a single-node model inadequate for locating the cause of deterioration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭
knowledge.text: 排水不是把壩基孔壓直接設為零，而是建立通向較低水頭邊界的有限導水路徑。岩體入流與排水出口共同決定節點水頭，出口淹沒會抬高整個系統的基準。
knowledge.textEn: Drainage does not simply set foundation pressure to zero. It provides finite conductance toward a lower-head boundary, while rock inflow and outlet conditions jointly establish the internal node head and submerged outlets raise that reference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水力阻力與廊道水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic resistance and gallery head" is correct?
options: 只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。
排水不是把壩基孔壓直接設為零，而是建立通向較低水頭邊界的有限導水路徑。
單一排水孔附近的低壓讀值足以代表整個壩底的揚壓。
optionsEn: Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location.
Drainage does not simply set foundation pressure to zero.
One low pressure reading beside a drain represents uplift across the entire base.
quiz.explanation: 排水不是把壩基孔壓直接設為零，而是建立通向較低水頭邊界的有限導水路徑。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drainage does not simply set foundation pressure to zero. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance and gallery head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Steady node head is 18 m in a linear lumped network.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic resistance and gallery head", which statement holds?
options: 排水流量減少總是表示滲漏減少，因此排水性能必然改善。
多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m。
optionsEn: Decreasing drain discharge always means less leakage and therefore improved drainage performance.
Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設上游水頭50 m、出口10 m，入流導度0.002、排出導度0.008 m²/s，穩態節點水頭(0.002×50+0.008×10)/0.01=18 m；線性集總模型。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume upstream head 50 m, outlet head 10 m and conductances 0.002 and 0.008 m²/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance and gallery head: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水力阻力與廊道水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance. Compare residuals across reservoir stages and verify that changing outlet submergence has not been mistaken for changing rock permeability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以水力阻力與廊道水頭編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic resistance and gallery head, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance. Compare residuals across reservoir stages and verify that changing outlet submergence has not been mistaken for changing rock permeability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只看排出流量，出口淹沒與排水阻塞可能產生相似結果，但內部壓力未必相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outlet submergence and obstruction can produce similar flow changes with different internal pressures. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。
knowledge.textEn: Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance. Compare residuals across reservoir stages and verify that changing outlet submergence has not been mistaken for changing rock permeability.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以水力阻力與廊道水頭編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic resistance and gallery head, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance. Compare residuals across reservoir stages and verify that changing outlet submergence has not been mistaken for changing rock permeability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水力阻力與廊道水頭」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic resistance and gallery head"?
options: 同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
圓孔的三倍應力係數可直接套用到任何矩形廊道角隅。
optionsEn: Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The circular-hole factor of three applies directly to every rectangular-gallery corner.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測上下游水位、排水流量與節點孔壓，核對入流等於出流後再擬合導度；在不同庫水位比較模型殘差，並確認出口尾水變動未被誤算成岩體滲透率改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure reservoir and outlet levels, drain flow and node pressure together, checking mass balance before fitting conductance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水力阻力與廊道水頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance and gallery head: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水力阻力與廊道水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic resistance and gallery head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只看排出流量，出口淹沒與排水阻塞可能產生相似結果，但內部壓力未必相同。非線性裂隙、暫態儲水和旁通通道會使單節點模型不足以定位異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水孔間距與覆蓋」與「導水能力的趨勢比較」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drain spacing and coverage" and "Conductance trend comparison": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drain spacing and coverage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水孔間距與覆蓋」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drain spacing and coverage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔數增加只有在與導水裂隙相交時才可能改善排水，均勻孔口間距不代表均勻影響範圍。覆蓋概念可先做幾何篩選，再用水力回應驗證相互影響是否連續。 假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。 實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。單一試驗水位得到的範圍可能隨裂隙開合改變，不能永久視為固定覆蓋圖。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水孔間距與覆蓋」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Additional drains help only where they intercept conducting fractures. Uniform collar spacing does not ensure uniform influence, so geometric coverage is preliminary screening that requires hydraulic response evidence to establish continuity. Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Adjacent influence zones leave a one-metre gap; this radius is an assumed teaching parameter, not a rock constant. Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected. Coverage observed at one reservoir level can change as fractures open or close and is not a permanent geometric guarantee. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drain spacing and coverage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水孔間距與覆蓋」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drain spacing and coverage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋
knowledge.text: 孔數增加只有在與導水裂隙相交時才可能改善排水，均勻孔口間距不代表均勻影響範圍。覆蓋概念可先做幾何篩選，再用水力回應驗證相互影響是否連續。
knowledge.textEn: Additional drains help only where they intercept conducting fractures. Uniform collar spacing does not ensure uniform influence, so geometric coverage is preliminary screening that requires hydraulic response evidence to establish continuity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水孔間距與覆蓋」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drain spacing and coverage" is correct?
options: 孔數增加只有在與導水裂隙相交時才可能改善排水，均勻孔口間距不代表均勻影響範圍。
排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。
排水流量減少總是表示滲漏減少，因此排水性能必然改善。
optionsEn: Additional drains help only where they intercept conducting fractures.
Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation.
Decreasing drain discharge always means less leakage and therefore improved drainage performance.
quiz.explanation: 孔數增加只有在與導水裂隙相交時才可能改善排水，均勻孔口間距不代表均勻影響範圍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Additional drains help only where they intercept conducting fractures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drain spacing and coverage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水孔間距與覆蓋」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drain spacing and coverage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Adjacent influence zones leave a one-metre gap; this radius is an assumed teaching parameter, not a rock constant. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Adjacent influence zones leave a one-metre gap; this radius is an assumed teaching parameter, not a rock constant.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水孔間距與覆蓋」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drain spacing and coverage", which statement holds?
options: 多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。
圓孔的三倍應力係數可直接套用到任何矩形廊道角隅。
optionsEn: Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m.
The circular-hole factor of three applies directly to every rectangular-gallery corner.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一維等效影響半徑2.5 m、孔距6 m，相鄰影響帶留下6−2×2.5=1 m缺口；半徑為教學假設，不是岩體固有常數。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume one-dimensional influence radius 2.5 m and spacing 6 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drain spacing and coverage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水孔間距與覆蓋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drain spacing and coverage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以排水孔間距與覆蓋編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for drain spacing and coverage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
knowledge.textEn: Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以排水孔間距與覆蓋編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for drain spacing and coverage, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Check deep borehole paths and unresponsive regions to determine whether apparent geometric overlap also has hydraulic evidence rather than relying on collar photographs.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水孔間距與覆蓋」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drain spacing and coverage"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩個壓力感測器的誤差不論是否相關都可以一律平方和開根號。
以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Errors of two pressure sensors can always be root-sum-squared regardless of correlation.
Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure.
quiz.explanation: 以同庫水位下相鄰孔壓和流量的相關變化辨認連通範圍，將結果投影到裂隙圖；查核深部孔跡和無回應區，確認幾何重疊是否也有水力證據，不能只靠孔口照片。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare neighboring pressure and flow responses at matched reservoir levels and map them onto fracture structure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排水孔間距與覆蓋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drain spacing and coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水孔間距與覆蓋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drain spacing and coverage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。單一試驗水位得到的範圍可能隨裂隙開合改變，不能永久視為固定覆蓋圖。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected. Coverage observed at one reservoir level can change as fractures open or close and is not a permanent geometric guarantee. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單一試驗水位得到的範圍可能隨裂隙開合改變，不能永久視為固定覆蓋圖。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Coverage observed at one reservoir level can change as fractures open or close and is not a permanent geometric guarantee.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。單一試驗水位得到的範圍可能隨裂隙開合改變，不能永久視為固定覆蓋圖。
knowledge.textEn: Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected. Coverage observed at one reservoir level can change as fractures open or close and is not a permanent geometric guarantee.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水孔間距與覆蓋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drain spacing and coverage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
排水流量減少總是表示滲漏減少，因此排水性能必然改善。
optionsEn: Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Decreasing drain discharge always means less leakage and therefore improved drainage performance.
quiz.explanation: 實際裂隙各向異性可能讓影響區狹長而非圓形，兩孔接近也未必相通。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Anisotropic fractures create elongated rather than circular influence regions, and close drains may remain disconnected. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 導水能力的趨勢比較：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conductance trend comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導水能力的趨勢比較」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conductance trend comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水流量必須與驅動水頭一起比較，因為庫水位降低本來就會減少流量。以流量除水頭差得到的表觀導度，可篩選退化趨勢，但仍需辨認岩體入流邊界的改變。 假設同一孔初始Q=0.004 m³/s、Δh=20 m，後來0.003 m³/s、Δh=25 m，表觀導度由0.0002降至0.00012 m²/s，下降40%；穩態線性假設。 流量下降同時伴隨水頭升高通常比單獨流量變化更值得調查，但仍不能僅憑比值定位沉積位置。管路漏失或量測分流也可能造成表觀導度下降而非孔內堵塞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導水能力的趨勢比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drain flow must be compared with its driving head because a lower reservoir naturally reduces discharge. Apparent conductance screens deterioration trends but still requires distinction from changes in rock inflow and outlet conditions. Assume flow and head change from 0.004 m³/s at 20 m to 0.003 m³/s at 25 m. Apparent conductance declines from 0.0002 to 0.00012 m²/s, or forty percent. knowledge.title: 量水堰校正與低流量
knowledge.text: 量水堰把水頭轉為流量，非線性指數使水位零點誤差在低流量時特別重要。自由出流、堰口形狀與接近流速都屬校正條件，淹沒後不能照搬原關係式。
knowledge.textEn: A measuring weir converts head into flow through a nonlinear relation, making zero errors especially important at low flow. Free discharge, notch geometry and approach velocity are calibration conditions that submerged operation invalidates.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：量水堰水頭偏差百分之二，計算流量也一定只偏差百分之二。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A two-percent weir-head error always produces exactly a two-percent discharge error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「量水堰校正與低流量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weir calibration and low flow" is correct?
options: 量水堰水頭偏差百分之二，計算流量也一定只偏差百分之二。
多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。
量水堰把水頭轉為流量，非線性指數使水位零點誤差在低流量時特別重要。
optionsEn: A two-percent weir-head error always produces exactly a two-percent discharge error.
Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows.
A measuring weir converts head into flow through a nonlinear relation, making zero errors especially important at low flow.
quiz.explanation: 量水堰把水頭轉為流量，非線性指數使水位零點誤差在低流量時特別重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A measuring weir converts head into flow through a nonlinear relation, making zero errors especially important at low flow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 量水堰校正與低流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weir calibration and low flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「量水堰校正與低流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weir calibration and low flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：率定係數1.4的單位為m^0.5/s。假設已校正九十度三角堰Q=1.4h^2.5，h以m、Q以m³/s，h=0.1 m得0.004427 m³/s；水頭偏高2%約使Q偏高5.08%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: The calibrated coefficient 1.4 has units m^0.5/s. Assume calibrated ninety-degree notch relation Q=1.4h^2.5 with SI units. At h=0.1 m, Q=0.004427 m³/s; a two-percent head bias raises discharge by approximately 5.08 percent. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立容積計時法交叉查流量，檢查水頭讀取位置、堰口清潔與下游淹沒；將零點偏移傳遞到整條率定曲線，尤其比較低水頭時的相對誤差與可辨識流量變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check discharge by independent volumetric timing and inspect head-reading location, notch condition and downstream submergence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以獨立容積計時法交叉查流量，檢查水頭讀取位置、堰口清潔與下游淹沒；將零點偏移傳遞到整條率定曲線，尤其比較低水頭時的相對誤差與可辨識流量變化。查核量水槽的側向漏水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check discharge by independent volumetric timing and inspect head-reading location, notch condition and downstream submergence. Propagate zero offsets through the rating curve, comparing relative error and detectable changes particularly at low heads. Check side leakage from the measuring chamber. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for weir calibration and low flow, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Cross-check discharge by independent volumetric timing and inspect head-reading location, notch condition and downstream submergence. Propagate zero offsets through the rating curve, comparing relative error and detectable changes particularly at low heads. Check side leakage from the measuring chamber.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：附著物改變堰口形狀，薄水舌黏附也會讓理想曲線失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Weir calibration and low flow"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以獨立容積計時法交叉查流量，檢查水頭讀取位置、堰口清潔與下游淹沒；將零點偏移傳遞到整條率定曲線，尤其比較低水頭時的相對誤差與可辨識流量變化。

steps.title: 量水堰校正與低流量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weir calibration and low flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「量水堰校正與低流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weir calibration and low flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 附著物改變堰口形狀，薄水舌黏附也會讓理想曲線失效。若只提高儀器顯示位數而未控制零點與出流狀態，流量數字看似精細卻可能系統性偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deposits alter notch geometry and clinging nappes invalidate the ideal rating. More display digits do not improve accuracy when zero and discharge conditions are uncontrolled, leaving precise-looking flow records with systematic error. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只提高儀器顯示位數而未控制零點與出流狀態，流量數字看似精細卻可能系統性偏差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: More display digits do not improve accuracy when zero and discharge conditions are uncontrolled, leaving precise-looking flow records with systematic error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「量水堰水頭偏差百分之二，計算流量也一定只偏差百分之二。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A two-percent weir-head error always produces exactly a two-percent discharge error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「量水堰校正與低流量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Weir calibration and low flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。
附著物改變堰口形狀，薄水舌黏附也會讓理想曲線失效。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows.
Deposits alter notch geometry and clinging nappes invalidate the ideal rating.

quiz.explanationEn: Deposits alter notch geometry and clinging nappes invalidate the ideal rating. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 集水井的暫態平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sump transient balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水井的暫態平衡」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sump transient balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 廊道集水井具有有限儲水量，平均抽排能力足夠仍可能在短時入流尖峰溢流。水量平衡應追蹤啟停延遲與共同排出管的限制，而非只把泵銘牌流量相加。 假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min；流量恆定、無額外容積。 液位計被泡沫或沉積干擾會延遲啟動判讀，共同排管堵塞可能同時降低多台泵能力。若把全部幾何容積當有效容積，便會高估可用緩衝時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水井的暫態平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gallery sump has finite storage, so adequate average pumping can still fail during an inflow peak. Storage balance must track start delay and common-discharge restrictions rather than merely summing pump nameplate capacities. Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s. Constant net inflow 0.01 m³/s fills the initially empty sump in 1200 seconds, or twenty minutes. Foam or sediment interferes with level sensing, while a blocked shared line can reduce several pumps simultaneously. Counting total geometric volume as usable storage overestimates buffering time and conceals the effect of activation thresholds. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sump transient balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min；流量恆定、無額外容積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水井的暫態平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sump transient balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水井的暫態平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sump transient balance" is correct?

steps.instruction: 液位計被泡沫或沉積干擾會延遲啟動判讀，共同排管堵塞可能同時降低多台泵能力。若把全部幾何容積當有效容積，便會高估可用緩衝時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gallery heat and ventilation scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 壓力差的不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure-difference uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力差的不確定度」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure-difference uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 判斷壓差趨勢需要把儀器隨機不確定度與共同系統偏差分開。兩個讀值的差可能抵消同源零點，也可能共享溫度誤差；是否相關決定合成規則。 假設兩壓力讀值的獨立零均值標準不確定度為2與3 kPa，壓差標準不確定度sqrt(2²+3²)=3.606 kPa；若相關係數0.5則為sqrt(13−6)=2.646 kPa。 把實際觀測偏差直接平方和開根號不是合成標準不確定度，忽略相關性也會高估或低估壓差誤差。小幅變化若低於量測可辨識尺度，不能逕自解讀成性能改善。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力差的不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interpreting pressure differences requires separating random uncertainty from shared systematic bias. A common zero may cancel while temperature errors remain correlated, so covariance determines how the uncertainties of two readings combine. Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties 2 and 3 kPa. Difference uncertainty is 3.606 kPa; correlation 0.5 changes it to sqrt(13−6)=2.646 kPa, with systematic bias assessed separately. Root-summing observed offsets is not uncertainty propagation, and ignoring correlation can overstate or understate difference uncertainty. Changes below measurement resolution and uncertainty cannot automatically be interpreted as improved hydraulic performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure-difference uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
